task: Write a 60–90-word data-use note and one APA 7 reference for the supplied fictional versioned dataset. Explain why version 2 should not be added to version 1 as though it were another observation period. Cite it as (Bex & Onsi, 2024). Venue reference mechanics: Authors' surnames and initials. (Year). Italicized dataset title (Version number) [Data set]. Publisher. URL. Cite the dataset actually used, not a nonexistent journal article. The supplied URL identifies version 2; no DOI, retrieval date, or archive is available or needed.

facts.text: Dataset record: Omi Bex and Ralo Onsi; Footpath puddle counts; version 2; 2024; Heronfold Observatory; https://example.org/data/footpath-puddles/v2.
Version 2 contains the same 16 observation rows as version 1.
Version 2 corrects the path-name column in four rows; it adds no observations and changes no puddle counts.
The current classroom analysis uses version 2 only.

forbidden_additions: A claim that the two versions supply 32 independent observations
A journal or conference identity for the dataset
An invented DOI, archive, retrieval date, or later version
preserve: Only path names changed; counts and observation rows did not
